name: g2_binaries_lpqi_pathfinder
label: The four binaries on the LPQI-Pathfinder (NOT + TNG, 532 m, five 1 nm filters, one filter per night; lensed IMSE array and MPD single pixel)
notes: At 471-550 m every catalog binary is resolved out (first null of a 1 mas disk at ~140 m for 500 nm): the table quantifies how far.

The bare (3.5 % fill factor) IMSE array of the Sensors paper is not a Pathfinder option any more (F. Prada, 2026-10-07); its backends lpqi_<filter> stay in the catalog as the published reference and can be added back with --set.
